comment: name -> BifrOSt/Linux command for os/cli rows. Unlisted names use their own name. A string value renames, null means no equivalent (gap). A name missing on the machine is a gap at run time.

no_exec.comment: present-check only: running these, even with --help, could change machine state

na_names.comment: Apple-only developer or hardware tools with no BifrOSt role

xcode-toolchain.reason: Xcode toolchain shim under /usr/bin; BifrOSt builds with cargo, there is no Xcode role

apple-hardware.reason: Apple boot, firmware, security-chip or Apple-silicon management; BifrOSt runs on PC hardware and has no equivalent role

na_patterns.reason: Apple platform daemon or agent under /usr/libexec; its job is done by BifrOSt springboard services, no command-line role
DTrace D script; DTrace is Apple/BSD only and BifrOSt traces with Linux tools
